body.x: Carmakers now buy as much software as hardware, yet they still shop for it across spreadsheets, email threads and trade-show chats. Comparing one supplier's code to another's has had no common yardstick.
SDVerse LLC was named a 2027 Honoree in Enterprise Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for SDVerse, an AI-powered digital marketplace.

Founded by General Motors, Magna and Wipro, SDVerse is described as the automotive industry's first AI-powered digital marketplace built for software, letting OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers and software providers discover, evaluate, compare and source vehicle software in a single structured environment.

At its core is a technical data model spanning more than 180 standardized attributes, including functional domain, safety certifications, operating systems, communication protocols, hardware compatibility and deployment models, which the description says makes software directly comparable across suppliers for the first time. AI capabilities built on that foundation, including natural-language search, specification-to-product matching and an intelligent marketplace assistant, compress discovery and evaluation from months to days.
Multi-level privacy controls enable secure collaboration between organizations, letting suppliers take part in technical evaluations without exposing proprietary information.

body.x: The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.

Ahead of CES 2027, AVING NEWS will host the 3rd Innovation Awards Winners Networking Party at MIK BASE CAMP on Wednesday, November 25, at 5 p.m. The event will also feature individual video interviews with participating companies, with registration available through Eventus. In early December, AVING NEWS will begin its pre-show coverage, including an interview program connecting Korean innovators with U.S. media outlets that regularly cover CES and participate in the Innovation Awards judging process.
* AVING NEWS uses AI-assisted tools in its editorial process.
